WITH mix_counts AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(tr.ordertypedist, '[missing]') AS mix, COUNT(*) AS mix_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
  GROUP BY COALESCE(tr.ordertypedist, '[missing]')
),
shares AS (
  SELECT mix, mix_count,
         CAST(mix_count AS REAL) / SUM(mix_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM mix_counts
),
scored AS (
  SELECT mix, mix_count, share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT mix, mix_count, share, share - average_share AS above_average_share
FROM scored
WHERE share > average_share;
